objectives.title: The report surface, one run per state

runs.title: A run whose report is a content audit
runs.summary: Nine items, two of them stops, with previews and a pilot deviation.
runs.full_description: Opens the four-case corpus: the largest of the real reports, the one with children-less items, two stop points and a null verification.

runs.title: A run whose report declares more items than it carries
runs.summary: Four items and an items_note that declares twenty-two checks and five decisions.
runs.full_description: The case that made the volume criterion exist: the file says, in its own note, that it is a sample of a larger run.

runs.title: A run whose report has an item with children
runs.summary: One parent item with three children, one of them a stop, and two previews that open side by side.
runs.full_description: The N+1 index case: a parent and its children are four separate signatures, and the parent wears the attenuated stop mark.

runs.title: A run whose report has no checks at all
runs.summary: Two items, one decision and a gate that is mechanical.
runs.full_description: The empty-versus-absent case: three blocks are empty lists and none of them is undeclared, so the surface says none six times and not declared zero times.

runs.title: A run whose report carries all twenty-eight of its items
runs.summary: The volume fixture: the twenty-eight items the development case declares, replicas marked.
runs.full_description: The size the renderer had never been driven at before this run measured it.

phases.title: Runs whose report is absent, incomplete or unreadable

runs.title: A run whose report does not parse
runs.summary: A report.json that is not JSON.
runs.full_description: The index keeps the entry and annotates it; the surface opens it and shows the parser's own message rather than an empty screen.

runs.title: A run with a report folder and no report in it
runs.summary: reports/<run_id>/ exists and holds no report.json.
runs.full_description: A started emission is not a missing one, and the index files it under unresolved rather than dropping it.

runs.title: A run for which no report was ever emitted
runs.full_description: The honest absence: nobody ever filed one, and the surface says so instead of staying silent.
